results.title: Police inspector, 11 civilians killed in terror attacks on Nigerian villages - TRT World
results.snippet:
In a subsequent account, the police said Lakurawa terrorists attacked communities along the Karwa, Kestu and Waiwayi axis between October 26 and 29, reporting 12 deaths during that period.

The Lakurawa group, also referred to by Nigerian authorities as Mamudawa, has been linked to attacks in parts of northwestern Nigeria, particularly in communities near the country's borders.
